main.description: How many accounts are going to and interested in a party event's calendar event, from any calendar app, and one account's RSVPs to it.

subject.description: The root's community.lexicon.calendar.event the RSVPs answer.

actor.description: The account to look up RSVPs for.

going.description: Accounts whose latest RSVP to it says going.

interested.description: Accounts whose latest RSVP to it says interested.

rsvps.description: The actor's RSVPs to it, oldest first. Usually one, but nothing stops an app writing two.

status.description: As the RSVP has it: community.lexicon.calendar.rsvp#going, #interested or #notgoing, or anything another app wrote.
